name: VAT (Standard Rate)
description: VAT 15% on (subtotal + NHIL + GETFund) — Act 1151, effective Jan 2026

name: Tourism Levy
description: Tourism Development Levy (L.I. 2185) — separate from VAT base

name: PAYE (Income Tax)
description: Progressive monthly PAYE on taxable income — GRA table, effective 1 Jan 2024 (confirmed current against gra.gov.gh/domestic-tax/tax-types/paye/). Edit the tiers below if GRA revises the bands; the last tier (rate 35, no 'upto') is intentionally open-ended.

name: Provident Fund Manager
description: Not a withholding — this rule only stores the voluntary Tier 3 provident fund tax-relief ceiling (% of basic salary) so it can be revised without a code change. Tier 3 itself is employee-elected (see Employee.tier3ContributionPct); this rate is the cap on how much of that election is tax-relieved. VERIFY current NPRA guidance before relying on this for a real payroll run.

name: SSNIT
description: Mandatory basic national pension, remitted to SSNIT: 13.5% of BASIC SALARY only (5.5% employee, 8% employer) — allowances, bonuses, and overtime are excluded from the base. Capped at the monthly insurable-earnings ceiling, floored at the minimum insurable earnings. Rename this rule to match how you refer to it on payslips (e.g. "SSNIT") — the rename is purely cosmetic and does not change the calculation. VERIFY the current rate/ceiling/floor against SSNIT guidance before relying on this for a real payroll run.

name: Enterprise Trustees
description: Mandatory occupational pension, remitted to a licensed private trustee (separate institution from Tier 1/SSNIT): 5% of BASIC SALARY, employer-funded only — no employee deduction. Same base rules as Tier 1 (basic salary only, capped/floored at the insurable-earnings limits). Rename this rule to your actual trustee's name — cosmetic only. VERIFY the current rate against your trustee/NPRA guidance before relying on this for a real payroll run.

name: Withholding Tax (Goods)
description: Resident WHT on supply of goods exceeding the GRA invoice threshold — 2026 rate

name: Withholding Tax (Works)
description: Resident WHT on works/contracts (e.g. construction, building works) — 2026 rate

name: Withholding Tax (Rent)
description: Resident WHT on rent of business premises — 2026 rate
